body:
### Clause
- IEEE Std 1800-2017: §19.9 Predefined coverage system tasks and system functions (p. 584)
- IEEE Std 1800-2023: §19.9 Predefined coverage system tasks and system functions (p. 612)

### Normative requirement (quoted <=40 words)
"$set_coverage_db_name ( filename ) sets the file name of the coverage database into which coverage information is stored at the end of a simulation run. $load_coverage_db ( filename ) loads from the given file name the cumulative coverage information"

### Runner probe and observed result
Probe file: `tests/1800_audit/c19/p19_09_systasks.sv`

```systemverilog
module test;
  initial begin
    $set_coverage_db_name("audit_cov.db");
    $load_coverage_db("audit_cov.db");
  end
endmodule
```

Observed result:
On Slurm job 3002 (pinned toolchain `iverilog` SHA `17661deebeaf8180f5761c82d1eeb31f30b5605739c724cb82dc4a04975a8256`), calling `$set_coverage_db_name` and `$load_coverage_db` in both `-g2017` and `-g2023` emits runtime warnings:
`WARNING: $set_coverage_db_name cannot select a functional-coverage database because that backend is unavailable.`
`WARNING: $load_coverage_db cannot load a functional-coverage database because that backend is unavailable.`
No coverage information is saved or restored.

### Expected behavior
The simulator must provide functional coverage database persistence, storing coverage information at end-of-run via `$set_coverage_db_name` and restoring cumulative coverage across all covergroup types via `$load_coverage_db`.
title: [IEEE 1800] §19.9 — Functional coverage database save and load tasks ($set_coverage_db_name, $load_coverage_db) backend unavailable
